retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast tropical sunset scene featuring a central silhouetted palm tree and a seated figure against a vibrant yellow-to-magenta gradient sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic 1980s-style composition featuring a lone palm tree leaning diagonally from the bottom right toward the center, with a person silhouetted at its base, set against a saturated sunset over a calm ocean.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal palm tree trunk bisecting the lower right quadrant
High-contrast silhouette against a bright yellow and pink gradient
Horizontal horizon line dividing the lower third of the frame
Text elements positioned in the upper margin and corners
coreInvariants: Deep black silhouette of tropical flora

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A palm tree and seated figure occupy the right half, leaning toward the center; the figure is small relative to the tree height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, leaning trunk of the palm tree.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal trunk upward to the palm fronds, then moves across the horizontal text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of open sky on the left and upper portions provide breathing room for the saturated colors.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright yellow and orange (sky and water reflection)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in the sky with maximum value contrast between the light source and the silhouettes.
paletteRestrictions: Warm tones only for the background

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-condensed, heavy vertical strokes with sharp, angular terminals
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, lowercase script with a thin horizontal line running through it
characterSpecificRedesigns: The display letters have exaggerated verticality and tight kerning
The script letters are connected by a continuous horizontal rule
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, condensed display face with a light, airy, wide-tracked script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy vertical feel of the display text.
Provides the informal, handwritten contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 80s-style photograph of a tropical beach at sunset. A single palm tree leans from the bottom right toward the center. A person is sitting at the base of the tree. The sky is a vibrant gradient of yellow at the horizon to magenta at the top. The entire foreground is a dark silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white ultra-condensed sans-serif name in a black-bordered box in the top right. Add a lowercase script title across the top center with very wide tracking and a thin white line running through the middle of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the palm tree leaning diagonally?
Is the sky a yellow-to-pink gradient?
Is there a horizontal line through the script text?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the person
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast silhouette against the sky
Ensure the sky gradient is smooth and vibrant
Verify the typography is positioned in the upper third
Confirm the presence of the horizontal line through the script text
recipe.reuseFormula: Tropical Silhouette + 80s Gradient + Condensed/Script Typographic Pairing
